title: The Playoff Prices Differently
meta_description: Week-1 AP No. 1 made the College Football Playoff 5 of 8 times from 2018-2025. In 12-team seasons, 13 of 24 slots sat at 11-25 or off the week-1 poll.
excerpt: From 2018 through 2025, week-1 AP No. 1 made the CFP 5 of 8 times and the top 4 made it 17 of 32. The 12-team field took more teams from 11-25 and from outside the week-1 poll.
